newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2915 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2930 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on a technical rebound after Thursday's sharp loss, traders said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2914.
The yuan opened up at 8.2912 and moved in a narrow range between 8.2910 and 8.2920 for most of the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2900 and a low of 8.2989.
Trading was less active than on Thursday with most business done at 8.2916, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan's rebound today was expected after it had been pushed down sharply on Thursday by speculative selling.
"The yuan was up today, but it was not a solid rise," the dealer said. "There was heavy selling around 8.2900. The fall on Thursday has hurt pro-yuan sentiment to some extent."
Traders said they expected the yuan to fall marginally early next week.
The yuan closed down at 7.2750 from 7.2343 against 100 Japanese yen and lower at an intraday low of 1.0710 from 1.0700 against the Hong Kong dollar.
